purpose: Component-level inventory across Profile-B presets. Shows which excipients are PRESET-LOCKED vs comparatively studied. Prevents unrestricted ingredient menus.
design_rule: Components are properties of a preset, NOT free user selections. A component becomes user-selectable ONLY if comparative quantitative evidence within a compatible system exists.

charge_modifier.name: stearylamine
charge_modifier.effect: positive zeta (+26 mV); ALSO changes lipid matrix - charge not isolated

surfactant_emulsifier.name: TPGS (d-alpha-tocopheryl PEG-1000 succinate)
surfactant_emulsifier.note: acts as surfactant + stabilizer; NOT comparatively varied in Chen

comparative_evidence_available.surfactants: NONE within a compatible celastrol system opened here (Chen does not compare surfactants). A surfactant SELECTOR is NOT justified.
comparative_evidence_available.surface_charge: Chen compares cationic/neutral/anionic BUT with confounded lipids -> charge is a preset CONFIGURATION, explained as observed-association not isolated-cause.
comparative_evidence_available.coatings: HA / PEG appear only in identified (unopened) systems -> coatings become SEPARATE presets, not toggles on P1.

everything_else: preset-locked or informational-only until comparative primaries are opened
